scoredBy: dispatcher (Claude Opus 5.5), from the lane's headless-Chrome shots and state checks, after all five existed; criteria frozen in CRITERIA.md
defaultWhy: Scalars board scores 95/100: it is the TensorBoard layout you described — runs on the left grouped by target with tag and regex filters — and it opens on one verdict card per target (ff v2 −43 % RMS error, FB share 23 % → 6 %, high confidence), then a chart per metric × target where each config group is a percentile fan once it has more than N runs (slider) and plain lines below that. Closest alternative: Target cards (90), the calmer page with the torque budget per group on every card.
decisionHinge: How much the summary is for picking runs versus reading the torque budget. Move 10 points from 'runs grouped by target' (A2) to 'torque budget at summary level' (A4) and Target cards edges ahead, 94 to 93. The splice that removes the hinge: Scalars board's run sidebar and metric × target grid, with Target cards' verdict and per-group FF | FB budget bar heading each target column, and League table's sortable row (ISO 9283 RT, drive gap, saturation) as a second tab.

a1: Three verdict cards above the fold: per target the winner, the margin (−43 %, −52 %), FB share 23 % → 6 %, and a confidence line (47/48 run pairs); 'nothing to compare' on pick-swing.
a2: TensorBoard-style sidebar: runs under their target with counts, select-all per group, regex filter, ff model / date / kind tag chips, colour key.
a3: Every chart draws each config group as lines up to N runs (slider) and as a median · IQR · p5–p95 · min–max fan past it; Lines / Bands override; pin a run over its fan.
a4: Feedback-torque and FB-share-over-time rows per target and a saturation badge; no per-run budget bar.
a5: 'run view ↗' on every chart and a click on any line or band opens that run.
a6: Runs aggregate into fans and groups collapse; the grid grows one column per target, which gets wide past ~5 targets.
